name: Auth + onboarding
working_tree_note: Report includes uncommitted OTP/retry follow-up changes and dashboard/device evidence gathered after commit f08dd00.
summary: B2 Auth + onboarding is proven 5/5 using the local automated B2 gate plus device verification for OTP, Google, and Apple across staging and production.

notes: Simulator keychain was reset between provider tests where needed because iOS Keychain/SecureStore can survive app uninstall.
Expo dev launcher auto-discovery was unreliable; the dev client was opened with exp+parse-receipt-scanner://expo-development-client/?url=http%3A%2F%2F192.168.1.6%3A8081.
Production email template updates appeared to require propagation time before OTP emails stopped falling back to the default confirm-link template.

evidence: T2.frontend-static passed: typecheck and lint completed.
T2.backend-static passed: category fixtures, onboarding RPC migration, and auth redirects verified.
T2.db-reset passed: local Supabase reset applied B1+B2 migrations and seed.
T2.1-T2.5-db-verify passed: categories, complete_onboarding RPC, health_check, and profile/category RLS verified.
Remote database was up to date during B2 environment validation.
Remote database was up to date during B2 environment validation.

tests.description: OTP request + verify creates auth user + profiles row with country and default_currency set
evidence: Staging OTP fresh signup sent code, verified 8-digit OTP, reached onboarding/camera, and DB showed completed profile/category mappings.
Production OTP email template eventually propagated; fresh OTP verified and DB showed provider email, onboarding_complete true, country IN, default_currency INR, category_count 10.

tests.description: Apple and Google sign-in complete on device builds; session survives restart
evidence: Staging Google fresh signup produced provider google, onboarding_complete false before category save, then onboarding_complete true and category_count 10 after Continue to camera.
Staging Apple sign-in produced provider apple, onboarding_complete true, country IN, default_currency USD, category_count 10.
Production Google produced provider google, onboarding_complete true, country IN, default_currency USD, category_count 10.
Production Apple produced provider apple, onboarding_complete true, country IN, default_currency USD, category_count 10.
Returning relaunch landed directly on camera for staging OTP, staging Google, staging Apple, and production completed-user sessions.

tests.description: New-user route sign-in -> categories -> camera; Miscellaneous pinned/locked; picks persisted
evidence: Staging OTP and Google fresh-user tests landed on category onboarding before camera.
DB showed initial category_count 1 for fresh provider users before onboarding, representing pinned Miscellaneous.
After onboarding, category_count became 10 for OTP, Google, and Apple completed profiles.
Production completed profiles for email, google, and apple all persisted category_count 10.

tests.description: Returning user cold-starts straight to camera in under 2 s
evidence: User visually confirmed returning relaunch landed directly on camera after staging OTP.
User visually confirmed returning relaunch landed directly on camera after staging Google.
User visually confirmed returning relaunch landed directly on camera after staging Apple.
User visually confirmed production relaunch landed directly on camera for completed Apple session.
simctl launch command timings observed: 182ms, 202ms, 181ms, and 221ms for representative relaunch checks.

tests.description: RLS negative: user A's JWT cannot read user B's profile or categories
evidence: scripts/verify-b2-db.js inserted user A/user B fixtures, set local role authenticated for user A, and verified user B profile/category rows were not readable.
npm run gate -- b2 completed successfully after local Supabase reset.
